canonicalLabel: The State guarantees the social right.

condition.note: No precondition attaches to this guarantee in this example.

description: Synthetic example: a persistent affirmative relation whose evidential state is expected to remain 'supported' across successive source states, because a supporting evidence basis is admissible throughout (see conformance case T01). This object carries NO temporal interval; persistence is a computed property of evidence admissibility, not a stored field.
